tr.help.analysis.body:
Güven % ve Hedef hata %
%95 güvenle ortalamanın gerçek değerden en fazla %5 sapması isteniyor demektir. Hata % bu sınırı aşan adım Yetersiz olur: o adım için daha çok çevrim ölç.
Tempo %
Çalışanın hızının normale göre değerlendirmesi. %110 = normalden %10 hızlı; normal süre buna göre uzatılır.
Tolerans %
Kişisel ihtiyaç, yorgunluk ve beklenmeyen gecikme payı. Standart = Normal ÷ (1 − tolerans). “Toleransı kalemlere ayır” ile her kalemi ayrı girebilirsiniz; hesapta toplamı kullanılır.
Baz → Normal → Standart
Baz: ölçülen süre. Normal: tempo düzeltmeli süre. Standart: toleranslı, planlamada kullanılan süre.
Her N çevrimde ve Katkı
Her çevrimde yapılmayan adım (örn. 3 siparişte bir kontrol) için N gir; katkı = standart ÷ N. Katkıların toplamı çevrim başına standart süredir.
Grup (ms)
Benzer süreleri gruplamak için aralık. “Tekrarlanan düşük süre” yöntemi en sık tekrar eden grubu baz alır.

en.help.analysis.body:
Confidence % and Target error %
With 95% confidence, the mean should be within 5% of the true value. A step whose Error % exceeds this is Insufficient: measure more cycles for it.
Pace %
Rating of the worker's speed against normal. 110% = 10% faster than normal; the normal time is lengthened accordingly.
Allowance %
Margin for personal needs, fatigue and unavoidable delay. Standard = Normal ÷ (1 − allowance). Use “Split the allowance into parts” to enter each part separately; the total is used.
Base → Normal → Standard
Base: measured time. Normal: pace-adjusted time. Standard: with allowance, used for planning.
Every N cycles and Contribution
For a step not done every cycle (e.g. a check every 3 orders) enter N; contribution = standard ÷ N. The contributions add up to the standard time per cycle.
Group (ms)
Interval for grouping similar durations. The “repeated low time” method uses the most frequent group as the base.

en.help.measure.body: <dt>VA · value-adding</dt><dd>Work the customer pays for: picking, packing.</dd><dt>SVA · necessary, non-value-adding</dt><dd>Required by the current method: preparation, scanning, checks.</dd><dt>NVA · waste</dt><dd>Waiting, searching, needless walking. The first target for improvement.</dd><dt>Cycle</dt><dd>One complete repetition of the job (e.g. one order). Each step is measured once per cycle.</dd><dt>Out of scope</dt><dd>An interval that is measured but left out of the standard time (e.g. an unusual stoppage).</dd>

en.s.help.body: <dt>Share</dt><dd>Observations in the category ÷ all observations. Many observations at random moments estimate how time is spent.</dd><dt>Confidence interval</dt><dd>Share ± z·√(p(1−p)/n). At 95% confidence z ≈ 1.96.</dd><dt>Required observations</dt><dd>n = z²·p(1−p) ÷ e², where e is the target absolute error (e.g. ±5 points). The largest n is enough for all categories.</dd><dt>Random moments</dt><dd>When observation times are not known in advance, workers do not change their behaviour and the result is unbiased. Use a fixed interval only if it does not coincide with the work cycle.</dd>

en.tour.1.text: Start a new study or open a saved one. To try it out, “Open demo study” comes with ready measurements. Studies are stored on this computer; take a backup with Back up all now and then.
en.tour.1.title: 1 Studies
en.tour.2.text: List the steps in process order or copy them from another study. Here you choose whether to use line balancing, standard work, ideas and step cards; if you don't, the screens stay simple.
en.tour.2.title: 2 Setup
en.tour.3.text: Play the video; press Start once when the first step begins, then Enter whenever a step ends. The next step and cycle advance automatically. Fix records one by one in the table, or select several with Ctrl/Shift and change them together.
en.tour.3.title: 3 Measure
en.tour.4.text: Standard time, sufficiency, cycles and distribution are here. Click the settings summary line to change settings. When done, set the study status to Completed or Approved and use Export for Excel or PDF.
en.tour.4.title: 4 Analysis
en.tour.5.text: The lean tools you chose in Setup open here. You can always reopen this tour with Quick tour at the top right.
en.tour.5.title: 5 Improve
